entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I... I think I need to return it, but I'm a bit lost with the whole process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Of course. The name is Maria Flores, and the order number is... VF789012.

Thank you, Maria. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. It looks like it was delivered to you on December 10th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, no it works fine, I think. It's just... it's a lot more complicated than I expected. I feel overwhelmed by all the features. I really don't think it's for me.
I understand that new tech can sometimes have a learning curve. I'd be happy to walk you through some of the core features or direct you to our simple start-up guides if that would help?
No, I appreciate that, but I'd really just prefer to send it back. I was looking on the website and it was all so confusing, I couldn't find the right information. Can't you just help me?
I see. Maria, looking at the delivery date of December 10th, that was 25 days ago. Unfortunately, it's now too late to process a return for this item.
Too late? But I thought you had a 90-day policy? I'm so confused. I'm a VIP member, doesn't that help?

I do see you're a valued VIP member, and I appreciate your loyalty. The 90-day policy applies to apparel like jerseys and shoes. For our electronic wearables, our return policy is 20 days from the date of delivery.
But... I barely even wore it. It's perfectly clean. Why is the policy so strict for this?
I understand your frustration. The main reason is for health and sanitation. Because the band is worn directly against the skin, we have a strict cutoff for returns due to hygiene protocols.
Hygiene? I don't understand. So there's nothing at all you can do for me? I just feel so helpless.

I wish I could offer a different solution, but the policy is firm on this. Once it's past 20 days, we simply cannot accept it back into our inventory. It's a matter of ensuring product sanitation for all our customers.
So I'm just... stuck with it? I spent a lot of money on this.

In terms of a return to VeloFit for a refund, I'm afraid so. However, one option many customers use is our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. You can list your gently used band there for other VeloFit enthusiasts.
Oh... I don't know if I can figure that out. This is all just too much. I guess... that's it, then.
I am truly sorry we couldn't resolve this with a return today, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No. I suppose not. Thank you for your time.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
